violations.why: irq_vine can preempt main between the two reads of v_larch in fn_delta and change the value, so the two reads can disagree.
irq_nectar can preempt main between the two reads of v_loom, once irq_flint has set v_walnut to 0, and change the value.
irq_vine has higher priority than irq_lantern. It can preempt after lantern writes 42 and reset v_velvet to 0 in fn_tide, so the check at line 159 sees 0.
irq_vine runs fn_wharf(1), which writes v_velvet=0 at line 127. If that happens between lantern's write and its read, the read sees a different value.
irq_vine can preempt lantern between its write of v_knoll and the read in fn_wharf. It overwrites v_knoll, though with the same value.
